mechanism.claim: A canonical block whose header timestamp retreats by at least 300 seconds from its predecessor, while remaining above the predecessor MTP, reveals consensus-valid miner-clock disorder. Fade the strict completed two-hour BTC impulse after six confirmations and a conservative two-hour header-time embargo.
mechanism.why_distinct: HBDC uses header timestamp ordering relative to the predecessor and predecessor median-time-past. It is not a block interval level, throughput, fee, fullness, empty-template, drought-underfill, retarget, hashrate, candle-shape, flow, funding, premium, OI, or prior control rule.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: miner-clock disagreement can reveal disordered settlement timing during volatile price impulses; causal RV20 q90 remains only a later audit
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: consensus-valid header backsteps create naturally irregular sparse clocks

features.anchor: canonical block i with timestamp_(i-1)-timestamp_i >= 300 seconds
features.event: anchor and consensus-valid predicates both hold
features.confirmation: block i+6 must exist in the same canonical prefix
features.raw_availability: max header timestamp and mediantime from the beginning of the source prefix through block i+6, plus 7200 seconds
features.decision: raw availability ceiled to the next exact five-minute UTC boundary D
features.side_return: log(BTCUSDT close at D-5m / open at D-2h) from exactly 24 coherent completed five-minute aggregates; strict nonzero
features.dedupe: process anchors by increasing height and accept the earliest event whose entry is not before the prior accepted event's exit; never replace suppression
features.source_valid: contiguous canonical heights and hashes, positive exact block fields, unique coherent five-minute bars, no imputation

rv20_stress_slice.rv20: sqrt(365*mean exact daily returns^2 over t-20 through t-1)
rv20_stress_slice.threshold: numpy linear q90 over 756 strictly prior available RV20 observations
rv20_stress_slice.future_use: only after all sequential full-calendar stages pass

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not an input; exact realized funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final
post_stage_volatility_audit.persistent_long_vol_comparator: same accepted clock and 0.5 gross, side forced long
post_stage_volatility_audit.rv20_q90_decomposition: same decomposition on causal RV20 q90 decisions

definitions.small_backstep: header backstep strictly between 0 and 300 seconds
definitions.non_backstep: same source clock without timestamp retreat
definitions.one_event_stale_side: primary side shifted by one accepted event

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no block predicate, threshold, confirmation, embargo, side, clock, hold, RV20, subset, comparator, control, or gate repair
